svg.text: Hydrogen chain, open: the best energies at each size
62 Hamiltonians, one panel per set of couplings, at every size with a published result. Each size is placed against its exact
energy where it has one (sizes in grey), otherwise against the standing record (sizes in orange), whose holder then sits in the
band above the plot. One line per method family through its best energy at each size. Here the axis is inverted: a better energy
Below the energy it is measured against

Sizes are numbers of sites. A family's line joins its best energy at each size, whichever paper set it, so one line can join several calculations.
Where the reference is the record, the heights show how far the other rows are from it, and nothing about the record itself.
